propositions: The voter-errors alarm currently fires on a single error marker in any 5-minute window, producing frequent false positives from transient self-healing events (review timeout retries, clone stalls, retryable-gap escalations) that resolve without operator intervention.

Sustained voter failures (expired token, LLM outage, Gerrit down) produce a continuous marker stream across consecutive evaluation periods because the webhook queue and backfill reconciler retry continuously on every review attempt.

The alarm must be recalibrated to 3-of-5 datapoints (rather than single-period threshold) to detect persistence: isolated transients clear within one period or straddle a boundary (≤2 breaching periods), while a stuck gate fires within ~15 minutes (3rd breaching period).

The recalibration from evaluation_periods=1 to evaluation_periods=5 and datapoints_to_alarm=0 to datapoints_to_alarm=3 is implemented in monitoring_s4b.tf with updated alarm_description; terraform apply must be performed manually by an operator per provision-restore.md, not by the implementer.
